messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout -> env=prod services=[runtime, api, console] tag=rel-2026-03-20+7 commits={runtime:c3f4a9, api:a1b2c3, console:9d8e7f} canary: runtime=10% api=10% console=10% change_window=2026-03-20T21:30-22:30Z
maya: Ack. Kicking off. I'm watching canaries + perf dashboards.
sam: Runtime canary up, initial token p50=82ms, p95=240ms. No OOMs in pods.
li: API canary returning 200 for most, but seeing a small spike of 502s on /v1/generate, ~0.8% over the last minute. Investigating.
zoe: Console canary healthy so far, UI load times normal. Note: console talks to api directly for auth checks.
li: Found error in upstream timeout config for a1b2c3 -> gateway default 1s, backend sometimes takes 1.4s for cold path. Reverting gateway tweak now.
deploy-bot: Update: api canary error-rate=0.9% -> PAUSING api rollout, keeping runtime/console on canary.
maya: Pausing makes sense. @zoe any dependency concerns if console stays on canary while api is paused?
zoe: Console can still talk to the paused api canary if sticky routing used, but we risk misaligned behavior for new sessions. Recommend pinning console to prev tag until api is stable.
sam: Runtime is independent, I recommend we continue runtime promotion if no regressions. Runtime performance looks good.
omar: @maya I'm on incident duty — if we rollback api canary I can run the rollback and monitor. Confirm?
maya: Yes please roll api back to prev tag. We'll promote runtime and pin console to prev. Keep release notes updated.
tess: Product note: no customer-facing feature flags tied to these tags. Good to proceed carefully.
li: Rolling back api canary -> target tag=prev-2026-03-18 (commit f0e1d2). Command: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=42`
deploy-bot: Action: api rollout rollback initiated by li. Status: in_progress.
li: API rollback completed. Post-rollback smoke: /health 200, error-rate <0.05%.
omar: Running synthetic sign-in flows and sample generation, looks clean. No 502s after rollback.
zoe: Pinning console to prev tag: console@prev-2026-03-18 applied. Confirmed session auth flows.
sam: Promoting runtime: canary->stable. runtime now at rel-2026-03-20+7 across 100% of pods. Observability: token p50=80ms, p95=220ms, error-rate=0.01%.
maya: Good. Updating release notes: runtime promoted, api rolled back to prev-2026-03-18, console pinned. Adding notes about gateway timeout fix and follow-up for api retry tuning.
deploy-bot: SUMMARY: runtime=promoted tag=rel-2026-03-20+7 status=ok; api=rolled_back tag=prev-2026-03-18 status=ok; console=pinned tag=prev-2026-03-18 status=ok. Change window still open until 2026-03-20T22:30Z.
maya: Thanks everyone. @li please open a PR with the gateway timeout config change + test plan. @sam create a quick perf regression eval for runtime just to be safe.
li: Will do. PR queued.
sam: Got it, adding perf eval.
omar: I'll keep monitors quiet for 30m and then hand back oncall.
tess: Noted in release notes, preparing the customer summary for tomorrow if needed.
deploy-bot: Deploy thread closed for now. If further changes needed, start a new rollout thread or reply here to reopen.
